title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
lineage: Master Soundboard Cassette > Reel to Reel > DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1982 show with scorching Let It Grow and a legendary Scarlet > Fire, captured on a solid soundboard tape despite occasional mix quirks.
ai_review.review: The concert is widely praised for its fire‑starter setlist – Let It Grow, Scarlet > Fire, Sailor > Saint and a ripping Truckin' leading into Stella Blue – all delivered with the tight, high‑octane playing that defined the band’s prime in ’82. The soundboard source is generally clear and well balanced, though several listeners note occasional level clipping and a mix that pushes Jerry low and Brent heavy. Overall the performance and recording are considered a must‑listen for fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Average rating of 4.3 across 18 detailed reviews, with consistent praise for musical performance and only minor, non‑show‑stopping recording complaints.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall tape with good instrument separation; occasional high‑level clipping and mix imbalance (Jerry low, Brent heavy) are noted but do not detract significantly from listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as solid and tight; second set flows beautifully with a seamless transition from Scarlet into Fire, delivering a high‑impact climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solos are described as scorching, frenetic and ‘out of his head’; some reviewers note his guitar is buried in the mix during parts of Fire.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lesh provides a fast, tight groove that anchors the band, especially noted on Scarlet > Fire.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocals are praised as strong and prominent throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboards shine with inventive solos; his presence in the mix is sometimes described as heavy.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart and Bill Kreutzmann deliver a tight, layered rhythm section with notable “pre‑drums” energy on Fire.
